text: 十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议3日上午在北京人民大会堂举行第二次全体会议。会议听取了中国人民银行行长潘功胜受国务院委托作的关于金融工作情况的报告。全国人大网11月5日发布了《国务院关于金融工作情况的报告——2026年11月3日在十四届全国人民代表大会常务委员会第二十五次会议上》。报告称，实施好支持资本市场的货币政策工具，支持中央汇金公司发挥类平准基金作用，拓宽中长期资金来源、渠道和入市方式，巩固完善资本市场稳市机制；维护股票、债券、外汇等金融市场平稳运行。
text_en: The second plenary session of the 25th session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee was held on the morning of the 3rd at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing. The meeting heard a report on financial work delivered by PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng on behalf of the State Council. The NPC website published on November 5 the "Report of the State Council on Financial Work — Delivered on November 3, 2026 at the 25th Session of the 14th NPC Standing Committee." The report said: implement monetary policy tools that support the capital market well, support Central Huijin Company in playing a quasi-stabilization fund role, broaden medium- and long-term funding sources, channels and market-entry methods, and consolidate and improve the capital market stabilization mechanism; maintain the smooth operation of the stock, bond, foreign exchange and other financial markets.
